fit.sheet: TI OPAx134 data sheet SBOS058B (revised November 2024), at ±15 V
fit.figure: Electrical characteristics at ±15 V: AOL 120 dB typ, GBW 8 MHz, slew rate 20 V/µs, open-loop output impedance 10 Ω at 10 kHz, 4 mA per amplifier, swing limits (V+) − 1.2 V and (V−) + 0.5 V at 10 kΩ; phase margin about 45° read off Figure 5-9
fit.method: A small macromodel (scripts/fit_models.py opamp_card, D-162): a tanh transconductance stage limited to 10 µA into C1 sets the slew rate, gm the unity-gain crossing and R1 the open-loop gain; a second pole gives the phase margin; diode clamps and an output resistance set the swing; the supply current is drawn from the rails. Output resistance the sheet's 10 Ω, clamps 1.1 V under V+ and 0.4 V over V− so the swing sits inside the 10 kΩ and 2 kΩ limits (the sheet gives no typical). Checked: slews at 19.9 V/µs.
fit.note: Input bias, offset, noise, common-mode limits and the output's current limit are not modelled: the input stage is ideal (1 TΩ).
